outcome: Germinal matrix hemorrhage and intraventricular hemorrhage (GMH-IVH)
cohort: The study included 136 preterm infants with a gestational age <32 weeks or with birthweight <1500gr who were admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
finding: MPV levels were significantly higher in preterm infants with GMH-IVH and a MPV cutoff of >9.95 was predictive for GMH-IVH, while a MPV cutoff of >10.55 fL predicted mortality.
